goal: Rewrite all public KitCode READMEs into an up-to-date dual-audience harness: extremely clear for non-tech users first, then agent/developer source-of-truth guidance, with mandatory terminal-capable chat and Ask-for-approval-off setup gates.

in: Rewrite root README.md as dual-layer product guide + agent harness.
Rewrite packages/kitcode-cli/README.md aligned with root facts and CLI deep detail.
Rewrite apps/web/README.md aligned with root; keep dashboard/gateway focus and link to root for agent setup.
Document mandatory setup gates: terminal-capable Codex (Task OK, regular chat not OK), Claude Code for Claude, and Ask for approval must be fully off.
Keep facts current with CLI surfaces, commands, counting, rewards, privacy, and local API.
Avoid contradictory copy across the three READMEs.
out: No AGENTS.md creation in this requirement.
No runtime source, gateway UI, generated skill/prompt, or installer behavior changes.
No publishing process redesign beyond keeping existing accurate notes.

acceptance_criteria.summary: Root README opens with a non-tech What/Setup/Surfaces/Privacy path, then an Agent/Developer harness section.
Docs hard-require terminal-capable Codex (Task allowed; regular chat not) or Claude Code, and require Ask for approval to be fully disabled before setup.
CLI README stays the deep command/API truth and does not contradict root setup gates or surfaces.
Web README documents dashboard/gateway only and points to root for agent setup gates.
Agent sections state that KitCode CLI output is the reward/tracking source of truth and agents must not calculate or mutate rewards themselves.
Documented commands and surfaces match current CLI help: add/remove/track/untrack/list/status/summary/awards/dashboard/terminal/pet/setup/uninstall/codex/claude; Mini via companion/setup only.

coverage_plan.summary: Manual review that all three READMEs include the setup gates, dual-audience structure where applicable, and no contradictory command/surface claims.
coverage_plan.command: manual doc review against bin/kitcode.mjs help and integration setup rules

risks.summary: Web gateway and generated setup prompts still use softer wording than the new hard README gates.
risks.mitigation: Keep runtime/UI out of scope; document the hard rule in READMEs and note UI sync as a follow-up if needed.

risks.summary: Putting every API detail in root can bury the non-tech path.
risks.mitigation: Keep root human-first and short; push deep CLI/API detail into the package README.

risks.summary: agent/contracts/cli-command-contract.json is narrower than current CLI help.
risks.mitigation: Prefer bin/kitcode.mjs as command source of truth for README facts; do not shrink documented commands to the stale contract.

implementation_handoff.summary: Rewrite the three public READMEs into a consistent dual-audience harness with mandatory terminal-chat and approval-off setup gates.
suggested_sequence: Rewrite root README with For people then For agents/developers sections and hard setup checklist.
Rewrite CLI README to match root gates while keeping command/API depth.
Rewrite web README to stay dashboard-focused and link root for agent setup gates.
Cross-check commands/surfaces against kitcode help and remove contradictions.
current_behavior_evidence: Root and package READMEs currently duplicate technical detail and soft-pedal agent environment requirements.
project-gateway.tsx already mentions Claude Code / local Codex, but wording is recommendatory rather than mandatory.
bin/kitcode.mjs help lists pet, setup, uninstall, summary, awards beyond the older cli-command-contract snapshot.
